question: What is the purpose of the saṃhitā fire offering that the teacher now declares?
premises: The teacher announces a saṃhitā fire offering.
This offering has a specific effect.
Its effect is the cutting away of all faults.
inference: The saṃhitā fire offering is taught as a means to remove all faults.
plain_english: I will now explain the saṃhitā fire offering, which cuts away all faults.
